_comment: DATAQUALITY SCALES over a datagen source: scale_samples_spec.md's 22 columns -- identity, linear, monomial, logarithmic and exponential, each with the doc's min, max, N and power or base -- for 100 triggers of 1000 rows, with boolean classifiers and ScaleCategorizers of every scale type, so the DQ summaries show the scales and the trends the booleans. DOMAIN: dev (no system). COLLECTION dq_scales (datagen_in): scales_tick, a DataGenSrc of 100 one-row chunks, and ten DataGenSrc publishers triggered by its table (TablesTrigger dq_scales/tick), five tables each, every table a Data of 100 x 1000 rows with chunk_size=1000. Trigger t emits each column's points drawn with an exponent that sways between 1/2 and 2 (trigger 0 of samples_reference is the doc's table), and per column a count of null, out-of-range (a tenth of the span past either end) and, for a float, NaN rows its profile sets -- the table's, improving, degrading or seasonal, or for nine columns across the families a jumpy one of their own, volatile (up and down 57+ rows a run) or spiky (a spike every ninth run) -- each changing every trigger. TABLES (50): scales_identity, scales_linear, scales_monomial, scales_logarithmic, scales_exponential -- the family's columns as <family>_plain (no DQ), _bool, _scale, _all and _all_coarse (4 bins); scales_mixed -- mixed_scale_1..3 and mixed_all_4..5, one column per family, so every table carries categorizers of all five scale types; scales_samples -- the doc's whole table as samples_reference (no DQ, no defects), samples_bool, samples_scale, samples_all, samples_all_coarse; trend_improving, trend_degrading, trend_seasonal -- a table per family under one profile, kinds rotating. 9 plain, 9 bool, 12 scale, 20 all. DQ: bool -- per column IsNotNull, IsBetween over its range and, for a float, IsNotNan, and Summary(trend=SummaryTrend()); scale -- per column the scale its relation calls for (IdentityScale with use_bin_zero, LinearScale, MonomialScale with its power, LogarithmicScale with its base, ExponentialScale; id_seq's span, over 100, takes a LinearScale, id_zero's is binned 0-99, pow_inv's power -1 an ExponentialScale) and Summary(trend=None), the trend being on by default; all -- both. The plan is functions/scale_plan.py. STAGES: (1) domains; (2) collection; (3) functions, the tick first; (4) actions, tagged live -- 100 passes 30s apart, each `tdk fn trigger` on scales_tick in the background beside a 30s sleep, then a wait for it: a pass is 30s, or its plan's time when that is longer -- the ten publishers, their summaries and trends -- as two plans of the same DataGenSrc publishers never overlap; (5) actions, tagged check -- scripts/verify_dq_scale_samples.py: per table a version per trigger; per DQ table a summary per trigger, the last holding exactly the planned classifiers and the boolean tallies the plan makes, histograms adding up with both ends seen; per table with booleans a trend whose n-th run is trigger n's counts exactly, and its week, month and folded rows adding up; mixed_all_4 and samples_scale read deep, every histogram moving every version; (6) monitor. Not under a bare `--suite dataquality`. Run: `tdd xp one-shot --suite dataquality/trends/datagen_scale_samples --keep`.
